text:
anya: Quick sync — product needs a dashboard for SLO-aware cost views. Want cost-per-1k, cache & batch savings breakout, and routing-tier split. Can runtime/infra teams sign up for telemetry fields?
ricardo: Looping infra. @samir can runtime emit per-request tokens + cache_hit boolean + batch_size + model_variant + routing_policy?
samir: yes, we can emit, but need schema + low-overhead path. Suggest aggregate counters + histogram for batch_size. Proposed minimal event fields:
```
{
 "request_id": "uuid",
 "model_id": "string",
 "tokens_input": "int",
 "tokens_output": "int",
 "cache_hit": "bool",
 "kv_cache_prefix_hit": "bool",
 "batch_size": "int",
 "sample_rate": "float (0-1)",
 "routing_policy": "string",
 "rollout_tag": "string",
 "is_dedicated": "bool"
}
```
meera: Console needs breakdown by per-route SLO tiers and ability to set 1k normalization. Also want alpha flag for canary traffic so we can exclude it from cost baselines.
jordan: agree. Also we need cost attribution: gpu_seconds * model_price_per_gpu_s + infra_overhead. Need fields to map GPU seconds per request or per batch.
anya: Important to show 'savings due to cache' as percentage and estimate $ saved per 1k tokens.
ricardo: telemetry path proposal: runtime -> kafka topic inference.telemetry.v1 -> flink/beam processor -> metrics warehouse. Include event sampling and aggregated rollups. Add `sampling_reason` when sample_rate < 1.
samir: implement v1 minimal event; for heavy routes we'll emit rollups every 10s with histograms for batch_size and tokens. We'll keep per-request path lightweight.
meera: Dashboard UX asks: table per-route, top N cost drivers, 1k-cost time series, waterfall chart raw_cost vs savings, and per-model filter + region filter. Need example payloads + sample dataset.
anya: Ownership: runtime team = emission, infra = ingestion/mapping, eng-platform = dashboard. Timeline: schema PR by Fri, runtime impl by next Wed, pipeline mapping next Mon, dashboard MVP next Thu. Who's in?
ricardo: i'll own pipeline mapping. INFRA will add the topic and eos semantics.
samir: runtime team ok for PR + impl. We'll provide rollup examples.
meera: console team will deliver wireframes and sample dataset. Need a small csv/ndjson with 500 rows.
anya: I'll upload sample dataset in #eng-platform later today and link here.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: INFRA-4123 telemetry pipeline mapping (https://tickets.internal/INFRA-4123)
jordan: one more ask — add tag `is_dedicated` for dedicated vs hosted to attribute reserved capacity costs.
samir: will add `is_dedicated` and `gpu_seconds` to rollups.
meera: :thumbsup:
anya: thanks, team — will follow up with checklist and PR link.
